title: Política
goal: Read about Ecuador's January 2000 crisis -- Mahuad's dollarization announcement, the CONAIE-backed takeover of Congress, and Noboa's unexpected decision to keep the dollarization in place.

items: Describe the economic crisis Ecuador faced in early 2000.
Explain what Mahuad announced on January 9, 2000.
Explain what Noboa did once he assumed the presidency.
Use en cuanto to link two closely timed events.
